name: DIY bridge shelf (T-shaped, across a KALLAX aisle)
description: One plywood board over the aisle plus a tongue on each side that slides all the way into a KALLAX cube and lies flat on its floor (screwed from inside), so the cube stays fully usable. Origin: back-centre of the aisle board, back against the wall.

source.notes: KALLAX cube inside 33.5 x 33.5, depth 39; tongue 33.2 wide.

aisle.description: cm between the two KALLAX fronts

tongueOffset.description: cm from the back to the tongue edge
